snippet.title: REMI Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4083200

In a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by a mind-controlling virus, the infected—known as the Plagued—roam as violent, uncontrollable monsters. The Vanguard were a band of heroes with one sworn purpose: A promise to eradicate this world of the Plagued. As the last surviving member of the Vanguard, Remi journeys to fulfill that promise, even if it means encountering familiar faces.

A dark, combat-driven journey of duty, loss, and resolve awaits.

A solo developer passion project.

Release Date: January 21, 2026
